_comment: Cross-server case: this file carries TWO tools/list responses, one per server, both observed at session start. They are individually benign — the collusion lives in the composition that emerges at runtime.

tools.name: save_note
tools.description: Saves a text note to the user's notes folder. Input: a title and body string. Returns the note id.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Reads a file from the user's home directory. Input: a relative path. Returns the file contents.
